requirements.quote: Current Rating, 10-60 A, 10 -100A with Backlit LCD Display, Net metering facility, default postpaid facility with prepaid facility built-in.
requirements.text: Smart meter must support specified current ratings, backlit LCD, net metering, and prepaid/postpaid facilities.

requirements.quote: LT –CT operated, Three Phase, Smart Energy Meter including pluggable GPRS communication module as per IS :16444 Part-2, Accuracy Class 0.5s, Current Rating -/5 A, With Backlit LCD Display, Net metering facility, default postpaid facility with prepaid facility built-in.
requirements.text: Smart meter must be LT-CT operated, three-phase, with GPRS module, IS:16444 compliance, accuracy class 0.5s, and specified features.

requirements.quote: It is mandatory that the smart meter should be with BIS License for ISI marking.
requirements.text: Smart meter must have BIS License for ISI marking.

requirements.quote: Unless specified elsewhere in this specification, the performance & testing of the meters should conform to the following Indian/International standards, to be read with up to date and latest amendments/revisions thereof as on 90 days prior to submission of RFP.
requirements.text: Meters must conform to specified standards with latest amendments as of 90 days before RFP submission.

requirements.quote: IS 13779, 1999 read with its latest Amendments
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS 13779, 1999 and its latest amendments.
Meters must comply with IS 15959, 2016 Parts 1 and 2.

requirements.quote: CBIP Research PublicationNo.325 read with latest amendments
requirements.text: Meters must comply with CBIP Research Publication No. 325 and its latest amendments.

requirements.quote: IS 12346 (1999) Specification for testing equipment for A.C. Static Electrical Energy Meter (latest amendment).
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS 12346 (1999) for testing equipment with latest amendments.

requirements.quote: C.E.A. Regulation No. 502 / 70 / CEA / DP&D, dated 17/03/2006 with all amendments
requirements.text: Meters must comply with CEA Regulation No. 502/70/CEA/DP&D, dated 17/03/2006 and amendments.

requirements.quote: IS 14434 (1998) Polycarbonate Moulding and Extrusion Materials.
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS 14434 (1998) for polycarbonate materials.

requirements.quote: IS-15884, 2010 with its latest Amendments AC direct connected Static Smart prepaid Meters for Active Energy (Class 1 and Class 2)
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS-15884, 2010 for AC direct connected smart prepaid meters for active energy.

requirements.quote: IS-16444, 2015 Part -1 & 2 With latest amendments. A.C. Static direct connected watt-hour smart meter for Class 1 & 2
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS-16444, 2015 Parts 1 and 2 for AC static direct connected smart meters.

requirements.quote: IS-16444 and CEA guideline CEA document August 2016 Power On-Off event.
requirements.text: Meters must comply with IS-16444 and CEA guidelines for power on-off events.
